summary.text: People's United Hearts is a human path killer move Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable created after reading The Legends of Ren Zu.

claims.text: Old Man Zheng Yuan tells Duke Long the circumstances. After eighteen variant human demonic immortals lost to Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable and then tried to deceive him, the venerable sat in a formation for three days and nights. The human path killer moves from that breakthrough also include countless lifeforms and common enemy hatred. Old Man Zheng Yuan is a rank seven human path Gu Immortal in Heavenly Court, a key to activate those remnant methods. Countless lifeforms has already been activated, and common enemy hatred is already effective in the whole of Central Continent. He says that once enough human will is gathered, they will be able to use people’s united hearts.

When enough human will has accumulated, Duke Long tells him to use it. Old Man Zheng Yuan stands and activates the immortal killer move. The accumulated human will is expended rapidly, almost none left. The entire Central Continent’s Gu Immortals, Gu Masters, and even mortals become enveloped in a halo of light that flashes for a moment. People find they are connected and can feel each other’s emotions: fear of attack, sadness and hatred at friends and family dying, worry for one’s life, and aspirations toward the future. Never had Central Continent’s people been so tightly connected. At a competition location, Unfettered Scholar is exposed like a torch in the darkness. At another ground, Zheng Qing is asked to show himself. Through the move the defenders can sense intentions and discern who the enemies are. Unstable elements hidden in the competition are eliminated.
Duke Long holds that fate Gu in Heavenly Court’s hands changes people’s hearts and merges will in a way no immortal killer move could match, even the rank nine killer move people’s united hearts.
